scientific_integrity: Analytical proof provided; reproducibility checks symbolic and finite only; no claim of independent review or uniqueness of prior-art search.
scientific_limitations: The exact limiting matched-centered variance is for a fixed three-category probability vector; no finite-N optimizer is asserted.
The boundary comparison is taken in the continuous limiting Gaussian coefficient, and is not a uniform-in-p CLT at moving p.
No global optimizer or unique interior minimum is claimed.
The primary Corrado (2011) article was inaccessible, so historical priority is not certified.
Only a same-model scientific review has been performed; independent validation has not been performed.
title: Local uniform optimality and global majorization failure for cyclic trinomial roughness
